description: Целевая модель Fabric; наличие исходного объекта не означает реализацию всех показанных контрактов. Runtime-состояние эта схема не измеряет.

modules.name: Проект и доступ

sources.excerpt: > **REVISED 2026-09-06 by [ADR-0039](../adr/0039-the-ceo-is-an-agent-after-all-and-the-line-moves-to-the-tools.md).** The operator chose an agent, for flexibility and tools. §1–§2 here (“not an agent loop”) and §5 (“no loop guards”) are superseded: the CEO IS a small tool-calling loop, with the four guards. transitions.carries: failure evidence, not a success claim

rules: Model confidence never substitutes for verifier evidence.

ack receipt matching delivery and task_run_id

transitions.guard: spawn handle proven but semantic delivery not yet confirmed

rules: Retry admission with same command ID returns same result.
No broad startup resume over all estates.

rules: Each explicit iteration is a whole run; unlimited display history via pagination, finite execution limits are mandatory.
Plan amendments create new revisions, preserve executed steps and invalidate affected gates; no retroactive denominator rewrite.

cycles.name: Восстановление без побочных запусков

transitions.carries: new epochs and explicit missed-window policy

rules: Replay is never an effect dispatcher.
Restored leases and in-flight effects reconcile before activation.

Activation is a separate command after current-authority fencing and per-intent reconciliation. Unknown effects remain held, and outbound consent/suppression cannot be rolled back by restoring an older archive.

rules: Reading never settles a question; feed dedup does not delete business obligations.

decisions.name: Развести WorkflowRun, TaskRun и итерацию
decisions.choice: Новый task_run_id после admission; старый run_id сохраняет graph-walk meaning.

decisions.name: Manager: scope, canonical role и epoch
decisions.choice: ceo/estate и product-manager/project; атомарное назначение с единственным effective writer epoch.

decisions.name: Ретро: локальная ценность и контролируемая отправка
decisions.choice: Local collection on; outbound separately activated with closed payload schema and durable suppression.

decisions.name: Автоматическая смена аккаунтов входит в объём
decisions.choice: Scope accepted by operator; detailed opt-in pool policy proposed. Switches require no second confirmation and use the verified resume transaction.

decisions.name: Персональный Fabric и пульс доказанной работы
decisions.choice: Цветной appearance revision принадлежит estate; activity, heartbeat, cycles и releases — разные проекции общего журнала. Контракт и P0–P6: docs/architecture/personal-fabric-pulse.md. D01 прежде runtime.
